citations.claim: At step 276 controller is in NS green (N green, S green, E/W red) with no active events.
At step 277 emergency on W becomes active and controller is in NS yellow (N/S yellow after only 1s of yellow).
At step 278 controller jumps to EW green (E/W green) after 0s all-red, violating all_red_clearance; first violation on approach 1.

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event on W at t=277 (events -> []); all other fields identical including steps=278. Predicted to remove failure because preemption no longer truncates yellow/all-red.

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=277 immediately forces the emergency direction to green, truncating the safety intervals: NS green at step 276 goes to NS yellow at 277 then EW green at 278, giving only 1s of yellow (need 5s) and 0s of all-red (need 4s). The counterfactual without the emergency runs the same 278 steps with no violation, confirming the emergency preemption path skips yellow-duration and all-red-clearance enforcement.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 4 s)

vision_note: North-south shows green through steps 275-276, then yellow in step 277. Step 278 immediately shows east-west green with no intervening all-red pause.
